task.title: Running the installation program
task.shortdesc: The installation program provides sections that step through necessary install options.

context.p: The installation program windows have Next and Back control buttons. Click Next to advance to the next step. Click Back to return to a previous window to review or make a change.A best practice for installing an upgrade build to any version is to clear your browser cache prior to installation. This removes any cached web resources that have changed since the previous installation or upgrade.

step.cmd: In the folder containing the extracted software zip file, right-click on the appropriate Installer file for your system, 64-bit (required for latest Niagara versions) or 32-bit or 64–bit (for earlier Niagara versions), then select Run as administrator.

info.note: On launching the Installer, if you receive an error message stating that the software is not supported on the current operating system, it may be due to a file property setting. Check the Installer file properties Compatibility tab to be sure the option to Run In Compatibility Mode is not selected. If it is, deselect it and run the Installer again.

step.stepresult: When launched, the installation program opens to the Welcome window.

step.cmd: On the Welcome window, click Next to continue.
On the License Agreement window, click Yes to accept the terms and then click Next to continue.
